technology_name: TORIN-2 WITH TWS119 FORMULATIONS TO MIMIC THE EFFECTS OF CALORIE RESTRICTION FOR NEUROLOGICAL DISORDERS
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Brain cancer treatment and cognitive prognosis tracking require targeted medications that can cross the blood-brain barrier to regulate multi-path neuro-inflammatory responses safely.
description: A targeted small-molecule therapeutic formulation combining the active mTOR inhibitor Torin-2 with the GSK-3beta inhibitor TWS119 to trigger neuroprotective pathways that mimic the anti-aging benefits of calorie restriction.
applications: Clinical brain cancer management, neurodevelopmental disorder therapeutics, chronic neuro-inflammation control, and advanced cognitive healthcare drugs.
